description: This file defines a wizard interface for generating an account balance report in an OpenERP (Odoo) module, including form definitions, validation, and report invocation.

classes.name: wizard_report
classes.description: A wizard interface class for account balance report generation, managing form defaults, validation, and report execution.

methods.name: _get_defaults
methods.description: Sets default values for the wizard form, including company and fiscal year.

methods.name: _check_state
methods.description: Validates the date range if the 'bydate' filter is selected.

methods.name: _check_path
methods.description: Determines the next wizard state based on the model context.

methods.name: _check_date
methods.description: Checks if the selected date range falls within a defined fiscal year.
